operations.title: List Preview Deployments
operations.description: List the preview deployments of an application, newest pull request first.

operations.title: Create Preview Deployment
operations.description: Open a preview deployment for a pull request and queue its deployment. When the preview already exists, it is redeployed. Git based applications need git_type unless they use a GitHub or GitLab App source; Bitbucket also needs commit. Docker Image applications need docker_tag for a new preview.

git_type.description: Git provider that hosts the pull request. Sets the ref Coolify fetches (pull/{id}/head or merge-requests/{id}/head).

commit.description: Commit SHA to deploy. Required for Bitbucket.

docker_tag.description: Docker image tag. Docker Image applications only.

instant_deploy.description: Queue a deployment. Set to false to only create the preview, for example to set its domains first.

operations.description: Create a persistent storage or file storage for an application.

name.description: Volume name (persistent only, required for persistent).

is_directory.description: Whether this is a directory mount (file only, default false).

fs_path.description: Host path. Required for directory mounts and host file mounts. Optional for file mounts with content (default: inside the resource directory). An absolute path can be anywhere on the host; a relative path is inside the resource directory. A directory or file mount outside the resource directory needs a token with the deploy permission. Coolify never deletes a path outside the resource directory.

name.description: The volume name (persistent only, not allowed for read-only storages).

mount_path.description: The container mount path (not allowed for read-only storages).

content.description: The file content (file only, not allowed for read-only storages). Changing the content of a file outside the resource directory needs the deploy permission.
